description: Understand the concepts of Reinforcement Learning, including Exploration vs. Exploitation Tradeoff, Introduction to Markov Decision Processes, Goal of Reinforcement Learning, Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

Know how to implement dynamic programming as an efficient solution approach to an industrial control problem, including Policy Evaluation (Prediction), Policy Iteration (Control), Generalized Policy Iteration, Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

Understand several algorithms for estimating value: Temporal-Difference learning, Monte Carlo, including Introduction to Monte-Carlo Methods, Monte-Carlo for Control, Exploration Methods for Monte-Carlo, Introduction to Temporal Difference Learning.
Understand and implement a model-based approach to RL: Temporal-Difference, Expected Sarsa, Q-learning, including Off-policy Temporal Difference Control: Q-learning, Expected Sarsa.

Understand several approaches that affect approximate value functions: supervised learning, fixed basis, neural network, including Estimating Value Functions as Supervised Learning, The Objective for Temporal Difference, Linear Temporal Difference, Feature Construction for Linear Methods, Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

Understand how function approximation is used to predict and control in Reinforcement Learning, including Episodic Sarsa with Function Approximation, Exploration under Function Approximation, Understand Average Reward, Learning Parameterized Policies.

Understand and implement an RL solution to a problem step by step: problem formulation, appropriate algorithm selection, implementation, and empirical study into the effectiveness of the solution, including Assignment guide , Assignment guide , Assignment- Assignment grading.
